high_level_description: The image shows a close-up of a plated dish that appears to be a gourmet avocado toast. The toast is topped with a vibrant green pesto sauce, which covers the entire surface. On top of the pesto, there are slices of ripe avocado arranged neatly. A cube of creamy white cheese, possibly feta or goat cheese, sits atop the avocado slices. A small piece of crispy bacon or a similar savory topping is placed on top of the cheese, adding a contrasting texture and color. A fresh basil leaf garnishes the dish, adding a touch of greenery and freshness.
